description: Search or list US federal government agencies tracked by the Federal Register (name, short name, slug, parent agency). Use the returned slug to filter federalregister.search by agency. Data: federalregister.gov (GPO/NARA), no auth required.

max.description: Maximum number of agencies to return (1-50, default 20).

query.description: Filter agencies by name substring, case-insensitive (e.g. "environmental"). Omit to list top agencies.

name: federalregister.agencies.search

error.description: Present only when the call failed. Includes error code, message, request_id, and any provider-specific extras.

result.description: Tool response payload. Shape varies per tool — consult the tool description and inputSchema. May be an object, array, string, or number depending on the upstream provider response.

title: Search Federal Agencies
